intents.response: UrbanSole offers a flexible exchange policy to help you get the perfect fit. You can request an exchange for a different size, color, or style based on availability.
To be eligible for exchange, the item must be unused, in its original condition, and in the original packaging, including the shoe box. The request must be made within 7 days of delivery.
Exchange requests must be made within 7 days of receiving your order.
Items marked as final sale or clearance, as well as personalized or customized shoes, cannot be exchanged.
You can exchange your product for a different size, color, or style, depending on availability.
